title: Reversal Energy 266/182 Gold Hyper Rare Pokemon Paradox Rift Special Energy
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Reversal Energy – Pokemon Paradox Rift – 266/182 – GOLD HYPER RARE
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.
Card details
Name: Reversal Energy
Card type: Special Energy
Set: Paradox Rift (PAR), 2023
Card number: 266/182
Rarity: Hyper Rare (Gold) – marked with the double gold star
Copyright: © 2023 Pokemon / Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK
Regulation mark: G
Language: English
Card text:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokemon, it provides Colorless Energy.
If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to an Evolution Pokemon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokemon ex, Pokemon V, etc. have Rule Boxes), this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 3 Energy at a time.
Note for collectors: this is the Gold Hyper Rare version. Paradox Rift has 182 cards in the main set, so 266/182 sits well past the main set and is one of the hardest pulls in the product. Hyper Rares use a full gold foil treatment across the entire card. Reversal Energy is also a competitively played card in its standard printing, so the gold version carries demand from players as well as collectors.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly. Gold foil cards show handling marks more readily than standard cards, so please review the photos carefully.
